# NexusCRM

> NexusCRM is an AI-powered CRM and field service management platform for service businesses — general contractors, landscapers, plumbers, electricians, HVAC, real estate agents, and accountants. Built and supported in Toronto, Canada by NexusAI GTA (nexusaigta.ca). Flat monthly pricing with unlimited users, all AI features included, and a dedicated private instance per client with Canadian hosting available.

## Key facts

- Product: NexusCRM, by NexusAI GTA (Toronto, Ontario, Canada). Contact: hello@nexusaigta.ca
- Pricing (CAD, flat, unlimited users, published): Core $295/month + $2,950 one-time implementation; Pro $425/month + $5,500 implementation (most popular); Elite $795/month + $9,800 implementation. No per-user fees. All AI included. Annual prepay earns 2 months free. 12-month initial term, then month-to-month.
- Deployment: single-tenant — every client gets a dedicated private instance and isolated database; Canadian data residency available (PIPEDA-aligned); clients own their data with full export.
- AI capabilities: voice-to-quote (record a site walk, receive a priced draft quote built from the company's own historical quotes), AI Bid Advisor (margin check against price sheets and up to 25 similar completed jobs), AI receipt capture (photo to itemized job expenses), AI scope-of-work and crew job sheets, and an AI assistant that can look up and update CRM records with user confirmation and a full audit trail.
- Core platform: lead intake (web forms, Meta Lead Ads), follow-up automation, multi-option quotes with online e-acceptance, automatic invoice and project creation, crew scheduling with Google Calendar sync, customer portal, live per-job profit and loss, payroll and commissions, role-based access control, audit logging.
- Roadmap (not yet available): SMS text messaging, online card payments, QuickBooks Online sync, customer self-booking.
- Implementation: typically live in about two weeks; includes branding, data migration, integrations, and team training.
- Partner program: referral (20% of MRR for 12 months + 15% of setup), certified reseller (25% of MRR for account lifetime + 30% of setup), and white-label (wholesale $2,995 + $235/month per instance; partner sets retail price).
